description:
List the public aid awards that BDNS, Spain's national database of
subsidies and other public aid, records for a company's tax ID, newest
first.

Use it for a known company (a slug from search_companies).

Returns JSON {company_slug, nif, link, shown_from, data_as_of, attribution,
totals {by_instrument, by_year}, count, next_offset, truncated, items
[{concession_id, granted_on, instrument, amount_eur, aid_equivalent_eur,
call {title, level, administration, body}}], note}. Only instrument
subsidy is a grant: a loan's amount_eur is the principal lent and a
guarantee's the amount guaranteed, so never call them grants. Totals are
per instrument; do not add nominal amounts across instruments. Awards
before shown_from are no longer shown by BDNS. Quote attribution and
data_as_of with the data. An empty list means none is linked in our data,
not that none was received.

Read-only. Needs the basic plan or higher: send your API key in the
X-API-Key header (https://bormeapi.com/account).

company.description: Company slug, as returned by search_companies or company_history, e.g. vaz-metales-sl.
company.title: Company

date_from.description: Optional earliest award date, YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2024-01-01.
date_from.title: Date From

date_to.description: Optional latest award date, YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2025-12-31.
date_to.title: Date To

instrument.description: Optional list of aid instruments, each one of subsidy, loan, guarantee, tax_advantage, risk_finance, other, e.g. ["subsidy"]; omit for all.
instrument.title: Instrument

offset.description: Awards to skip, integer 0-10000 (default 0); pass the previous page's next_offset, e.g. 50.
offset.title: Offset

name: company_grants
title: A company's public aid (BDNS)
